title: Index for linear-prefix proof coordinates
statement: For each $k\in\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$, define its linear-prefix proof index to be the position in a sequence of length $n+2(n+1)$ obtained by placing $k$ in the first of two blocks of length $n+1$, both of which follow an initial block of length $n$.
